newsitem.title: UK: Airtours gains as Hoare Govett ups estimates.
newsitem.headline: Airtours gains as Hoare Govett ups estimates.

text.p: Shares in Airtours Plc rose on Tuesday as analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett raised their earnings estimates for the holiday operator, dealers said.
The stock was up 36-1/2p at 11.35 stg by 1408 GMT in volume of 668,408 shares.
For the current year, Hoare Govett raised its pre-tax profit estimate to 137 million stg from 125 million. It repeated a "buy" recommendation on the stock, market sources said.
Analyst Andrew Hunter at Hoare, who covers the stock, was not immediately available for comment.
